k8s_events.message: Readiness probe failed for api: db connectivity check timed out

expected.root_cause: worker:v2.5-batch-jobs opens a DB connection per batch job but never returns it to the pool. Active connections climbed from 12 to the Cloud SQL max of 100 within 7 minutes, starving the api service of connections and causing its 500s.
expected.fix_description: Roll worker back to the pre-batch-job image to stop the connection leak, then restart api pods to clear the stale connections already held.
